description: Defines the FilterSourceStream class, a specialized SourceStream that reads from an upstream source and filters data, including method declarations, internal state management, and virtual methods for filtering data.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream that reads from an upstream SourceStream and applies filtering, with internal state management and virtual filtering method.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, implementing the SourceStream interface.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the stream.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if the stream may have more data.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Parses an encoding type from a string.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Internal method to manage the read/filter loop.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Virtual method to filter data, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of stream.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Determines if more input data is needed.
